integrity: The proof is self-contained and analytic. A finite checker is diagnostic only. Literature access was complete for the companion alpha-section paper and abstract-level for the short fair-partition note and Kincses paper; unindexed prior observations remain a residual originality risk.
scientific_limitations: Only nested ellipsoids are covered; the unrestricted higher-dimensional nested-convex-body problem remains open. The sufficient working normals are characterized after affine normalization by c·u>=0, but uniqueness or necessity is not claimed.
title: Uniform \(\alpha\)-section dominance for nested ellipsoids in every dimension
